audit.summary: The stated principal-triple slice is not surjective in permitted characteristics, including the sufficient prime range used downstream. Four local cohomology, root-sign, site and prime-set statements require correction. Main moduli-space conclusions are not thereby shown false.
limitations: The principal-triple slice is not surjective in permitted characteristics — Counterevidence: B.5 final determinant formula holds in all three explicit examples by centralizer weights. No counterexample to main moduli flatness, connectedness, B.5 final identity or Theorem5.7 established. Veldkamp uses its specified Chevalley sums, not automatically the principal F used here.

The full inertia H1 vanishing assertion is false — Counterevidence: The fixed-component obstruction factors through finite cyclic ell-group C. H1(C,T(L))=0 by invertibility of |C| on T(L), so the intended lifting can be repaired.

The finite-image adjustment uses the wrong root sign — Counterevidence: Choose r so g^r lies in identity component of the g-fixed inertia torus, then t^r=g^-r in that torus. It commutes with g and (tg)^r=1; same connected component preserved.

Central-isogeny exactness is asserted on the wrong site — Counterevidence: Central isogeny is fppf-surjective; finite etale component sheaves can then be handled in the etale topology. A.11/A.12 conclusions not refuted.
The introductory prime exclusions are reversed — Counterevidence: Section6 formal localization statement has the correct finite exclusions.

proposition.claim:
X -> F+X from g^E to g//G is an isomorphism for simple adjoint G and ell not dividing |W|.

L algebraically closed, G=PGL5, ell=7, q=3, trivial action; |W|=120, h=5, ord_7(3)=6. Principal triple E=Jordan5, F subdiagonal(4,6,6,4), H=diag(4,2,0,-2,-4).

H1(I_F,T(L))=1 because the action factors through a cyclic ell-group and T(L) is uniquely ell-divisible.

p2, ell3, T=Gm, L=Fbar3, trivial action.

Choose t^r=g^r and multiply the Frobenius value g by t to obtain finite image.

G=Gm, trivial action, phi(s)=1, phi(Fr)=2 over Qbar.

The displayed fixed-point/cohomology sequence is exact on the big etale site for all allowed central isogenies.

R=Z[1/3], Gamma=C3 trivial action, SL2->PGL2 with kernel mu2. A=F2[u,u^-1].

Positive M divisible by all LG-banal primes or their product.

Banal primes form a cofinite set; q2 trivial-action Gm gives all ell !=2.
